start.title: [TODO:ar] Empty Nets
start.text:
[TODO:ar] Dawn over the lake.
All night, and not one fish.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Stay
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Anger will not feed you.
Begin again.

leave_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Linger
leave_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Stay by the water.
A voice is coming.

teaching.title: [TODO:ar] A Stranger's Voice
teaching.text:
[TODO:ar] Crowds press near.
"May I teach from your boat?"

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Welcome Him
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His voice is gentle.
Give what little you have.

catch.title: [TODO:ar] Cast the Nets
catch.text:
[TODO:ar] "Cast into the deep," he says.
But the night gave nothing.

refuse_cast_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Trust
refuse_cast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His word is not like other words.
Lower the nets.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Obey
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] There is nothing to lose.
Do as he asks.

miracle.title: [TODO:ar] Nets Overflowing
miracle.text:
[TODO:ar] Fish surge, the nets break.
You fall to your knees.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Humble Yourself
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The miracle is not yours.
Kneel before him.

call.title: [TODO:ar] Follow Me
call.text:
[TODO:ar] "Do not be afraid.
From now, you will fish for men."

hesitate_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Step Forward
hesitate_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Boats and nets will pass.
His call will not.

bargain_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Today
bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Tomorrow is not promised.
Follow now.

follow.title: [TODO:ar] A New Road
follow.text:
[TODO:ar] Nets fall to the sand.
You walk into a new life.
